''See also: [[Longhook Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Longhook is an [[Underlord]] and emissary representing [[Redmoon Hall]]. He possesses a specialized weapon consisting of a heavy chain tipped with a thick meat hook, which is actually his [[Blood Shadow]] wrapped around a sacred weapon. He demonstrates significant speed and grace when manipulating this tool, which is powerful enough to pierce through a ship or shatter [[stone]]. In combat, Longhook can use his [[Blood Shadow]] to mimic his movements and has been seen wearing interlocking plates of gray [[Forged madra]] that serve as armor. Despite being wounded in battle—suffering injuries such as a blinded eye, a ruined arm, and a twisted knee—he has shown great resilience. His death was eventually confirmed by sect oracles, an event noted by the [[Blood Sage]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Longhook bears a cut along the side of his neck and has an eye that is nearly blinded. His body was previously reborn in [[soulfire]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|He utilizes the [[Path of Rolling Earth]] and the [[Mountain's Fist Enforcer]] [[technique]]. His combat involves a [[Blood Shadow]] wrapped around a sacred hook-and-chain weapon.}}
